name: Circle (Standard)
description_of_outcome: A circle, 10cm diameter, cut with scissors to a clean edge with no visible straight sections. Judged on roundness and edge quality.

name: Square (Standard)
tools_required: Scissors, ruler, set-square (if team has one)
description_of_outcome: A square, 8cm sides, cut with scissors. All four sides equal length (±2mm) and corners at 90°.

name: Triangle (Standard)
tools_required: Scissors, ruler, protractor (if team has one)
description_of_outcome: An equilateral triangle, 8cm sides, cut with scissors. Sides equal (±2mm), corners sharp and clean.

name: Pentagon (Complex)
description_of_outcome: A regular pentagon, 6cm sides. Requires accurate angle-marking — hardest shape to produce without a full tool set. Judged on equal side lengths and consistent interior angles.

name: Reef Knot
tools_required: None (bring own rope, or provided at station)
description_of_outcome: A correctly tied reef knot: symmetrical, lies flat, does not slip or capsize into a granny knot when pulled.

name: Clove Hitch
tools_required: Upright pole or staff at the station
description_of_outcome: A clove hitch tied around the pole that grips securely under load and does not slip when the rope is pulled along its length.

name: Bowline
description_of_outcome: A bowline forming a fixed loop that does not slip or tighten under load, tied within a reasonable time.

name: Sheet Bend
description_of_outcome: A sheet bend correctly joining two ropes of different diameters, secure and not slipping when pulled from both ends.

name: Square Lashing
tools_required: 2 wooden poles/canes, clamped or held at the station
description_of_outcome: A square lashing joining two poles at a right angle, with frapping turns, tight enough that the poles do not rotate or shift when gently tested.

name: Fire Lighting (no matches)
materials_required: Cotton wool ball, small tinder bundle
tools_required: Fire steel, fireproof tray, water bucket on standby (adult supervision required)
description_of_outcome: Team successfully produces a sustained flame from the tinder bundle using only the fire steel, within an agreed time limit and under supervision.

name: Map & Compass Bearing
tools_required: Compass, local map, pre-set bearing card
description_of_outcome: Team takes a given compass bearing and correctly identifies/walks to the matching point or feature within a marked margin of error.

name: Morse Code Message
tools_required: Torch or flags, Morse code reference sheet
description_of_outcome: Team correctly encodes and sends a short given message in Morse code, and/or correctly decodes a received one, within a set time.

name: Semaphore Message
description_of_outcome: Team correctly sends or reads a short semaphore message within a set time.

name: First Aid — Arm Sling
description_of_outcome: A correctly applied arm sling that immobilises the arm, is comfortably secure, and uses a reef knot to fasten.

name: Tripod Lashing
description_of_outcome: A tripod lashing joining three poles that stands freely and takes gentle weight without the poles splaying or the lashing slipping.

name: Model Bridge Build
materials_required: 20 lolly sticks, glue or tape, 1 sheet paper
description_of_outcome: A freestanding model bridge spanning a fixed 15cm gap between two supports, able to support a small weight (e.g. a full water bottle) without collapsing.

name: Mini Shelter Build
materials_required: Natural materials (twigs, leaves — gathered on site), 1 small tarp/fabric scrap, cord
description_of_outcome: A scaled-down shelter that would keep a small object (e.g. a toy figure) dry and off the ground, built to a taught, stable frame.

name: Sew a Button
tools_required: None (needle/thread reused if in good condition)
description_of_outcome: A button sewn on securely with at least 4 firm stitches through all holes, thread fastened off with a proper finishing knot.

name: Water Filter Build
materials_required: Sand, gravel, cotton wool, charcoal, cut plastic bottle
tools_required: Container of muddy/dirty water, clear cup to catch filtered water
description_of_outcome: A working layered filter that visibly clears muddy water (not for drinking) — judged on clarity of output and correct order of layers.

name: Puzzle Race
description_of_outcome: Team completes the puzzle correctly within a set time limit.

name: Spaghetti Tower
materials_required: 20 sticks dry spaghetti, 1 marshmallow, 1m tape, 1m string
description_of_outcome: Tallest freestanding tower that supports the marshmallow on top for at least 10 seconds, measured from the table.

name: Blindfold Trust Course
description_of_outcome: One blindfolded team member is verbally guided by teammates through a short cone course without touching a cone, within a set time.
